comments.author: Scara
comments.body:
shipwreck 8*, East India trade ship

14188/6032, latitude of Buenos Aires slightly south east of the landing point in the north

92 pearl shells, 7 tuna, 4 fine ruby, 55 platinum, 94 shrimp, 23 vintage of the covenant, 33 MCCT

npc 53, 51, 31

The ship is a big trading carrack
